The OpenObserve instance's rendered EnvironmentFile now sets RUST_LOG=warn and ZO_PRINT_KEY_SQL=false, silencing the instance's own INFO chatter (per-ingest access lines, tantivy/parquet job logs) and the parquet-merge job's println-based DataFusion plan dumps. Both re-entered the store through the local collector's journald pipeline as the largest log stream by far (~1.4M lines/day on production); the same values were applied to the live production instance, cutting its journal volume ~99.9%.
